series.title: Stellar Transformation Season 07
series.synopsis: The descent of Mount Tianzun and the appearance of the Spiritual Treasure Cauldron ignited a frenzied struggle among the God-Kings for the “Azure Heaven Seal,” the “Earth Seal,” and the “Seal of Ten Thousand People.” Qin Yu, a new father, is drawn into a conflict with powerful enemies like the Blood Sea Queen to save his brother Hou Fei. When Jiang Lan obtains the Earth Seal and becomes the target of everyone’s anger, Qin Yu displays astonishing strength, intimidating the assembled heroes.
